channel.title: Gorilla Family and Me
channel.desc: In the dangerous forests of the Democratic Republic of Congo Gordon Buchanan meets the fearsome leader of his gorilla family, Chimanuka, and two baby gorillas, one a lonely orphan. As Gordon gains the trust of these mysterious, seldom-seen gorillas as he discovers their incredible compassion and gets caught up in a battle between giant rival silverbacks for control of the family.
